summary.text: Jeanné Kapela was born in Kona, was raised in Captain Cook, and graduated from Konawaena High School in 2012.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislative biography, she served as Miss Hawai'i 2015 and founded Unite Hawai'i in 2015, an organization devoted to ending sexual exploitation through education.
The biography also says she serves as prevention education coordinator for Imua Alliance, a nonprofit service provider for victims of sex trafficking.
